subject: Credit note request for duplicate tax entry - VEN017-0052
body:
Dear Titan Industries Ltd team,

We have identified that credit note VEN017-0052 dated 14 Sep 2025 repeats VEN017-0025. The tax amount of Rs 13,997 has been counted twice for the same party and taxable value of Rs 77,762.

Please cancel the second entry so the tax is not counted twice.

Regards,
